units.rawText: The practice of swordsmanship is not to repeat day after day, tracing one action after the other. You'll grow fatigued of it sooner or later. Adequate rest and even entertainment are important too.

units.rawText: In my case, I spend 18 hours a day sleeping, watching TV, and taking baths to keep my mind in balance...
